question: What clinical entity is caused, mainly, by Clostridium difficile ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Clostridium difficile infection -> release of toxins -> damage to the intestinal lining -> inflammation -> diarrhea associated with antibiotics -> 95% CHAIN: Clostridium difficile infection -> overgrowth of bacteria -> disruption of normal gut flora -> diarrhea associated with antibiotics -> 95%
analysis: Clostridium difficile infection is mainly associated with diarrhea, particularly antibiotic-associated diarrhea.
